name: Currency Converter
clause: {T}: Put a card exiled with ~ into its owner's graveyard. If it's a land card, create a Treasure token. If it's a nonland card, create a 2/2 black Rogue creature token.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'exile'; ...; remember?: true } recording the exiled cards on the source, plus { op: 'bind'; as: 'that'; from: 'exiled-with' } and { op: 'move'; what: { ref: 'exiled-with'; count: Amount; choose?: 'you' } }
needs.semantics: Let a plain exile record what it exiled on GameObject.exiledWith (as delve / imprint already do) so a later ability of the same permanent can name it, bind ONE of those cards, and read owner-of-that / prop mv from it.
needs.clause: 'the exiled card's owner creates an X/X ... where X is the mana value of the exiled card' / 'Put a card exiled with ~ into its owner's graveyard.'
